question: GQ-004
action: independent re-derivation of the second self-referential claim
claim_headline: ~71 input tokens per call against ~41,000 through the full harness — a 577x ratio, and the basis for "safe to reuse".
finding: PROVENANCE DEFECT. The ratio is not mine, is undeclared, and is not reproducible from any log on this machine.

trace.1: The claim grounds in two quotes from my metrics file — both about licence and package resolution, NEITHER about tokens.
trace.2: The metrics file records adoption_cost.measured_input_tokens_per_call: 71 with no source and no derivation. Its four declared derivations cover licence and resolution only.
trace.3: The gateway log has no matching traffic. Smallest average across all providers is 11 tokens on 2 requests; there is no ~71-token lane.
trace.4: The numbers come from COMMENTS IN ~/bin/mini-pi, dated 2026-07-10, written by its author: "every bulk worker call ships ~40K input tokens (measured median)" and "measured ~71 fresh input tokens ... (~300-500x cut)".

verdict: The underlying figures may well be correct — mini-pi's author says they are measured. But my claim presents them as measurement without attribution, my metrics file restates them without a source, and nothing on this machine reproduces them. A reader would reasonably believe I measured 71 tokens. I did not; I read a comment.
also_note: The claim says the ratio is ~577x (71 vs 41,000). The source comment says ~300-500x. Even the restatement drifted.
what_is_solid: The resolution finding and rights gate ARE mine and re-derive cleanly: @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent installed, @mariozechner path absent, MIT, no LICENSE file shipped. Version 0.80.10 confirmed on disk, matching the claim.
action_taken: Confidence lowered and the token claim attributed rather than deleted. An unverified number with known provenance is more useful than a silent removal.
